app.welcome:
TidyDesktop is running.

A 'Tidy box' has been added to the desktop. Right-click the TidyDesktop icon at the bottom right of the taskbar (next to the clock, or under ^) for the menu. 'Sort into boxes by kind' puts your icons into boxes by what they are.

To get your old desktop back, choose 'Remove all boxes and restore icon positions' in the menu.
